title: Decentralized span ingestor, SLO-correlator, and quiet-hours paging routing
creator: Ava Moreno
description: Introduce a horizontally scalable span ingestion layer paired with an SLO-correlator service that links trace spans to SLO signal windows and routes page/noise-aware alerts based on quiet-hours and escalation policies. Goal: reduce noisy pages during low-traffic windows, improve root-cause correlation between latency spikes and recent deploys/kernel scheduling changes, and provide a lightweight anomaly score for burn-rate alerts.
acceptance_criteria: New span-ingestor deployed as a sidecar-enabled service with configurable sampling and backpressure behavior
SLO-correlator exposes an endpoint that returns correlated traces + anomaly score for a given SLO window (time range + service identifier)
Paging router respects quiet-hours rules and on-call overrides; testable via synthetic traffic and integration tests
Burn-rate alerts can optionally enrich incidents with top-3 correlated traces and the anomaly score
Dashboards updated: latency/error correlation panel, quiet-hours paging metrics, and SLO-correlator health
Automated integration tests run in staging and a canary rollout to 10% of production traffic with roll-back on SLA regressions
work_notes: 2025-02-12 - Ava M: Kickoff with SRE, product and oncall. Agreed target SLO windows: 5m/1h/24h for throughput-sensitive endpoints.
2025-02-14 - Ravi P: Prototype span-ingestor using existing kafka topic 'spans.v2' + fast-path consumer. Measured <6ms median ingest latency at 5000rps in local perf test.
2025-02-16 - SRE (Jordan L): Proposed quiet-hours policy: suppress pages unless anomaly_score > 0.85 OR critical error ratio crosses 3x baseline for 5 min. Added requirement for oncall override UI.
2025-02-18 - Design (Maya C): Dashboard mockups for correlated traces panel and quiet-hours override drawer. Shared link in Confluence.
2025-02-20 - Ravi P: Implemented SLO-correlator endpoint '/v1/correlate' returning trace IDs and anomaly_score. Added feature flag 'slo_correlator_v1'.
2025-02-22 - PR #8421: Initial implementation. Request review from infra and security. Notes: RBAC uses existing service-account token; KMS integration not required for metadata only.

2025-02-24 - Load test: Canary with 10% traffic. Observed traces enrichment at 95th percentile add 12ms to request path when enrichment turned on; we moved enrichment to async link to avoid tail-latency impact.
2025-02-26 - Ravi P: Added anomaly-detector model (simple EWMA + z-score with seasonal adjustment). Tuned thresholds with historical SLO windows from prod metrics store.
2025-02-27 - PM (Lina R): Approved rollout plan and customer communication template. Agreed to enable correlate enrichment only for P1 incidents initially.
2025-02-28 - QA (Omar S): Integration test green in staging. Preparing canary rollout playbook and runbook updates. Opening In Review for code and design sign-off.
decisions: Keep span-ingestor horizontally scalable and stateless; rely on external Kafka for durable buffering
Enrichment moved off critical path — SLO-correlator returns candidate traces and a precomputed anomaly score; full trace fetch deferred to on-demand retrieval
Use EWMA+zscore anomaly detector for v1 to keep compute costs low; plan to replace with model-based detector in v2 after 6 weeks of telemetry
Quiet-hours routing: default suppress pages for P2/P3 unless anomaly_score >= 0.85; P0/P1 still page after on-call check
Feature-flag gating for smoothing rollout; default off for existing customers; enable for Redwood internal orgs first
testing_plan: Unit tests for ingest/backpressure logic; injection of transient kafka failures
Integration tests that simulate deploy-induced latency spikes and assert correlator returns correct trace set
Canary: 10% traffic -> 30% -> 100% with SLA checks and automatic rollback on >2x error budget burn in 1h
Chaos test: kill correlator pod; verify alerts degrade gracefully and fallback to raw-metrics-only burns
notes_for_reviewers: Focus on the RBAC surface in the correlator and whether the diagnostic trace IDs leak sensitive metadata
Check performance implications of async enrichment and sizing guidance for correlator replicas
Validate quiet-hours suppression rules and confirm override UX meets oncall needs
slo_math_summary: Correlator computes anomaly_score per SLO window using EWMA baseline adjusted for daily seasonality. Burn-rate alert triggers when error_budget_consumed / error_budget_window_rate > threshold, then enrichment adds anomaly_score to prioritize pages.
oncall_changes: Added new paging policy: quiet-hours suppression by default; oncall can enable temporary override; escalation steps unchanged for P0/P1; updated oncall playbook in runbook link.
audit_trail_requirements: Log correlate requests and decisions (anomaly_score, trace_ids returned) for 30 days. Ensure logs are scrubbed of payload content and only metadata is stored.
final_notes: Ready for design and security review sign-off. Plan is to enable correlator enrichment for internal orgs 2025-03-05, then external customers according to canary results.
